targets.rawSql: SELECT MetricDate AS time, Dimension1 AS metric, Value * 100 AS value FROM beutl_analytics.grafana_analytics WHERE MetricName = 'retention_rate' AND $__timeFilter(MetricDate) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Monthly UTC cohort retention (small cohorts are suppressed)

targets.rawSql: SELECT MetricDate AS cohort_month, Dimension1 AS period, round(Value * 100, 1) AS retention_percent, SampleSize AS cohort_size FROM beutl_analytics.grafana_analytics WHERE MetricName = 'retention_monthly_cohort' AND $__timeFilter(MetricDate) ORDER BY cohort_month DESC, period

options.content: An active installation is one that successfully sent `app.session.start` in the selected UTC period. Retention is based on observed telemetry only; offline or opted-out use is not imputed. Cells with fewer than five installations are excluded.
